title: Compute efficiency: binary keeps only 0% of the multipliers busy

body:
With NX8's 8-bit static formats, the tensor that loses most even in its best format is linear bias in SamLowe/roberta-base-go_emotions: 33.6 dB SQNR (signal-to-quantization-noise ratio; higher is better) in fp8_e2m5, measured on that tensor alone by the format search. Measured on 12 models with a format search (of 279 surveyed).

Model outputs keep a median 23.2 dB SQNR against full precision, the worst 7.4 dB (stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5:vae). 8 of 10 models with a prediction metric (top-1, perplexity or agreement) lose some of it; the most: microsoft/table-transformer-structure-recognition (agreement 100% → 0%: the share of samples whose predicted class matches full precision's), stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5:vae (token agreement 100% → 43%: the share of token positions whose predicted token matches full precision's) and facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (token agreement 100% → 57%: the share of token positions whose predicted token matches full precision's).

The tensors that lose most in their best format (their own error): linear bias in SamLowe/roberta-base-go_emotions (fp8_e2m5, 33.6 dB), layernorm bias in jonatasgrosman/wav2vec2-large-xlsr-53-japanese (fp8_e3m4, 34.2 dB), layernorm bias in openai-community/gpt2 (fp8_e3m4, 34.5 dB), linear bias in stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5 (fp8_e2m5, 34.7 dB), layernorm output in SamLowe/roberta-base-go_emotions (fp8_e3m4, 35.3 dB), layernorm output in jonatasgrosman/wav2vec2-large-xlsr-53-japanese (fp8_e3m4, 35.5 dB), layernorm bias in BAAI/bge-small-zh-v1.5 (fp8_e2m5, 35.6 dB), add output in SamLowe/roberta-base-go_emotions (fp8_e3m4, 35.7 dB), linear output in stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5 (fp8_e3m4, 35.8 dB) and add output in BAAI/bge-base-en (fp8_e2m5, 35.8 dB).

Separately, the error accumulated along the data path (every tensor before a node quantized too): div outputs end furthest from full precision, microsoft/table-transformer-structure-recognition keeping only -inf dB there. The outputs furthest from full precision in each model's best format set: div in microsoft/table-transformer-structure-recognition (fp8_e3m4, -inf dB), mul in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e3m4, -3.8 dB), linear in PekingU/rtdetr_r101vd_coco_o365 (fp8_e3m4, -3.0 dB), sub in PekingU/rtdetr_r101vd_coco_o365 (fp8_e3m4, -2.4 dB), softmax in PekingU/rtdetr_r101vd_coco_o365 (fp8_e3m4, -1.1 dB), relu in PekingU/rtdetr_r101vd_coco_o365 (fp8_e3m4, -1.1 dB), div in PekingU/rtdetr_r101vd_coco_o365 (fp8_e3m4, -0.0 dB), mul in PekingU/rtdetr_r101vd_coco_o365 (fp8_e3m4, 0.5 dB), aten in PekingU/rtdetr_r101vd_coco_o365 (fp8_e3m4, 0.9 dB) and sum in PekingU/rtdetr_r101vd_coco_o365 (fp8_e3m4, 1.2 dB).

Formats chosen (E = exponent bits, M = mantissa bits, u = unsigned): fp8_e3m4 4473 (53%), fp8_e2m5 3172 (38%), fp8_e1m6 705 (8.37%), ufp8_e2m6 71 (0.84%), ufp8_e1m7 3 (0.04%), ufp8_e3m5 2 (0.02%); 0.90% of tensors use an unsigned format.

body:
3 missing capabilities keep 32 operations in 6 models (of 11 planned) off the chip's direct path; the most widespread is run-time addressing (a load from an address computed on chip) (29 operations in 5 models). Ranked by the MACs they hold:

**Run-time addressing (a load from an address computed on chip).** The chip cannot read memory at an address computed at run time, so every lookup or choice by a run-time value (embedding) needs a workaround. It affects 29 operations in 5 models: 29 calls (0.76% of all calls) and no MACs (data movement only); the biggest: embedding in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256, embedding in SamLowe/roberta-base-go_emotions and embedding in openai-community/gpt2. Cost today: 0 of 29 have a workaround (0 exact, 0 approximate), 2 failed and 27 wait for one; 103 workarounds proposed, 21 passing its check, 20 evaluated on a model; accuracy not measured yet; cycles not measured yet; 0 extra kernels.

**An integer format for indices.** No NX8 format can hold an integer index computed from the input, so the operations reading one (add and gather) need a workaround. It affects 2 operations in 1 model: 2 calls (0.05% of all calls) and no MACs (data movement only); the biggest: add in SamLowe/roberta-base-go_emotions and gather in SamLowe/roberta-base-go_emotions. Cost today: 0 of 2 have a workaround (0 exact, 0 approximate), 0 failed and 2 wait for one; 0 workarounds proposed, 0 passing its check, none evaluated on a model; accuracy not measured yet; cycles not measured yet; 0 extra kernels.

**An aten::conv1d instruction.** The chip has no instruction for aten::conv1d, so every aten::conv1d needs a workaround. It affects 1 operation in 1 model: 1 call (0.03% of all calls) and MACs not counted (the capture does not size an ATen op); the biggest: aten::conv1d in jonatasgrosman/wav2vec2-large-xlsr-53-japanese. title: Missing instructions: 32 operations in 6 models need workarounds

body:
A kernel reads a tensor in the arrangement its writer stored it in; when the reader needs another arrangement, the reading kernel has to rearrange the data itself. This happens to 675 of 1111 tensors passed between kernels (61%) in 11 models: 485 for attention heads split or merged, 169 for other reshapes, 18 for pixels reordered and 3 for image patches.

The reading operations are 445 operations (445 calls, 12% of all calls; 104 G MACs, 4.19% of all MACs). The most common causes (writer → reader): linear → bmm (attention heads split or merged) 262, linear → attention (attention heads split or merged) 207 and linear → add (other reshapes) 70; most in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (208), stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5 (128) and jonatasgrosman/wav2vec2-large-xlsr-53-japanese (87).

Cost today: extra cycles not measured yet (no reading kernel has run); 0 links fail.
title: Layout conversions: 675 of 1111 tensors between kernels are rearranged

body:
Activations such as exp, GELU and reciprocal go through a 256-entry lookup table (LUT), which limits their precision: 1,088 operations in 11 models (1,088 calls, 28% of all calls), most often layernorm (324), silu (210) and groupnorm (113). Their quantized accuracy: worst -inf dB SQNR over 634 measured operations.

Kernels per forward pass (host launches, one per planned kernel call): median 22, most 82 (stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5, 82 planned groups), over 11 models.

FP32 headroom (how far the largest value is from FP32 overflow, in powers of ten) is least at 33.4 powers of ten for bmm in jonatasgrosman/wav2vec2-large-xlsr-53-japanese (largest value 1.35e+05).

13 outputs in 1 model hold a value at the FP32 limit itself (mostly add (12) and select_where (1), e.g. an attention mask's fill value); they are counted apart from the headroom.

4 accuracy runs produced non-finite outputs (overflow or NaN).

0 kernels use over 80% of the 1,024-word instruction memory (IMEM) bank, of 1 kernel measured.
title: Resource limits: 1,088 operations limited by the LUT and up to 82 kernel launches per pass

body: The IPU architecture's most costly impact is on compute efficiency, where binary formats keep MAC utilisation at just 0% across all 23 measured cases — the pipeline cannot keep the multipliers fed at all. Next is the accuracy cost of NX8 8-bit quantisation: the worst tensors (linear bias, layernorm bias/output) lose down to 33.6 dB SQNR even in their best formats, 8 of 10 models with prediction metrics lose accuracy, and data-path error accumulation drives some outputs (div, mul) to −∞ or negative dB. Third is layout conversion: 61% (675 of 1,111) of inter-kernel tensors must be rearranged by the reading kernel — mostly for attention head split/merge — affecting 445 calls and 104 G MACs, though extra cycles are not yet measured. Fourth, missing instructions (run-time addressing, integer indices, conv1d) block 32 operations in 6 models from running directly, forcing workarounds that are 0% complete (0 exact, 0 approximate) with 2 failed and 27 pending. Finally, resource limits constrain 1,088 operations through a 256-entry LUT (worst 1.9 dB SQNR) and require up to 82 kernel launches per pass, with 13 outputs hitting the FP32 limit and 2 runs producing non-finite outputs.
title: GLM summary

body:
**Run-time addressing (a load from an address computed on chip)** would put 29 operations in 5 models on the chip directly, with no workaround: 29 calls (0.76% of all calls) and no MACs (they only move data); the accuracy it would recover is not measured yet (no workaround evaluated).

**An integer format for indices** would put 2 operations in 1 model on the chip directly, with no workaround: 2 calls (0.05% of all calls) and no MACs (they only move data); the accuracy it would recover is not measured yet (no workaround evaluated).

**An aten::conv1d instruction** would put 1 operation in 1 model on the chip directly, with no workaround: 1 call (0.03% of all calls) and MACs not counted (the capture does not size an ATen op); the accuracy it would recover is not measured yet (no workaround evaluated).
